decisive_items: contrast leakage from myocardium to pericardial cavity
response.rationale: Pericardial effusion with contrast extravasation from the myocardium plus hemodynamic instability indicates cardiac tamponade; the LCx thrombosis and ST elevation explain the inciting MI but not the pericardial leak.

rejected.why: No aortic dissection on CTA and D-dimer is normal; back pain is nonspecific and explained by pericardial irritation.
Too broad; the specific findings favor MI with mechanical complication/tamponade.
